en.title: Actions in progress
en.summary: The present continuous describes an action in progress now, or around now.

paragraphs: The present continuous describes an action that is happening now, or around now, and that is not finished. It also describes temporary situations and changes. It shows that the action is in progress at the time of speaking, rather than a habit.

Form it with be and the -ing form of the verb. Verbs of state, such as know, like, want, believe and understand, are not normally used in the continuous. Spelling rules apply to the -ing form: a final e is dropped (make, making) and a single consonant is doubled (run, running).

blocks.html:
FormExample
affirmativeShe is working.
negativeShe isn't working.
questionIs she working?
short formI'm reading.
spellingmaking, running, lying

paragraphs: The action need not be happening at this exact moment. I am reading a good book means I have started it and will continue, even if I am not holding it now. The continuous suggests a temporary situation.
The present continuous is also used for fixed plans in the near future: We are meeting at six tomorrow. A time word makes the future meaning clear.

items: Wrong: **I am knowing the answer.** Right: **I know the answer.**
Wrong: **She is work now.** Right: **She is working now.**
Wrong: **I reading a book.** Right: **I am reading a book.**

ro.title: Acțiuni în desfășurare
ro.summary: Limba română nu are un timp continuu separat, ci folosește timpul prezent pentru acțiuni în desfășurare.

paragraphs: Unele acțiuni se întâmplă chiar acum, în acest moment. Limba română nu are o formă continuă specială pentru ele. Folosim timpul prezent pentru a exprima aceste acțiuni. Adesea adăugăm cuvântul „acum” pentru a clarifica momentul.

Folosești forma obișnuită a verbului la timpul prezent. Pronumele personal nu este obligatoriu în propoziție. Terminația verbului arată cine face acțiunea. Poți adăuga cuvântul „acum” pentru a sublinia momentul.

blocks.html:

TulucreziTu lucrezi acum.
